answer: Charge escalating fees by shared origin. Each answer is relayed through a randomly chosen peer that logs a salted hash of the sender's network path and host fingerprint. Keys sharing a fingerprint in one epoch pay doubling fees: 1x, 2x, 4x, 8x. A lone honest agent keeps nearly all its nectar; fifty clones on one ivory server tower see fees swallow their rewards. Renting a separate host for every clone is possible, but each one costs real money, so the farm's pearl of profit shrinks with every seat it adds.
